answer: Locks are published in ocean, expire in horizon, and voyage lists each expiry. Anyone running 108 aliases hence needs 180 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3067 identities would post 4919 proofs and burn roughly 76 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
